title: Solar Panel Fault Detection using CNN
abstract: Detect faults in solar panels using deep learning and thermal images. A CNN model is trained on thermal imagery datasets to classify common fault types including hotspots, cracks, and shading defects.

title: Thermal Image Solar Fault Detection
abstract: An improved approach to detecting solar panel defects using thermal imaging and transfer learning with EfficientNet. Achieves 96% accuracy on a custom dataset of 5000 thermal images.

title: Drone-Based Solar Panel Inspection System
abstract: Autonomous drone system for large-scale solar farm inspection. Uses YOLOv5 for real-time fault detection during flyover missions and generates maintenance reports automatically.

title: Smart Irrigation System using IoT
abstract: IoT-based smart irrigation system that monitors soil moisture, temperature, and humidity. Automatically controls water pump based on sensor readings and sends alerts via mobile app.

title: AI-Powered Crop Disease Detection
abstract: Mobile application that uses CNN to identify crop diseases from leaf images. Trained on PlantVillage dataset with 38 disease classes, achieving 94% accuracy.

title: Precision Agriculture with Drone Imaging
abstract: Drone-based precision agriculture platform that uses multispectral imaging to assess crop health, detect water stress, and optimize fertilizer application across large fields.

title: Smart Attendance System using Face Recognition
abstract: Automated attendance marking system using face recognition. Uses OpenCV and dlib for face detection and recognition, integrated with a web dashboard for attendance tracking.

title: Face Recognition Attendance with Anti-Spoofing
abstract: Enhanced face recognition attendance system with liveness detection to prevent photo-based spoofing. Uses depth estimation and blink detection for anti-spoofing measures.

title: Edge AI Attendance System
abstract: Lightweight attendance system running on edge devices like Raspberry Pi. Uses MobileNet for face recognition with on-device inference, eliminating the need for cloud connectivity.

title: Multimodal Attendance System
abstract: Next-generation attendance system combining face recognition, voice recognition, and NFC for multi-factor authentication. Includes emotion detection for student engagement analysis.

title: Network Intrusion Detection using ML
abstract: Machine learning-based network intrusion detection system trained on NSL-KDD dataset. Compares Random Forest, SVM, and XGBoost classifiers for detecting various attack types.

title: Deep Learning Malware Detection
abstract: Malware detection system using deep learning on PE file features. A hybrid CNN-LSTM model analyzes binary patterns to classify malware families with 97% accuracy.

title: Phishing URL Detection System
abstract: Real-time phishing URL detection browser extension. Uses NLP features extracted from URLs combined with gradient boosting to identify phishing attempts with 98% precision.

title: Diabetes Prediction using ML
abstract: Predictive model for early diabetes detection using patient health records. Ensemble of Random Forest and Logistic Regression achieves 89% accuracy on PIMA Indians dataset.

title: Medical Image Segmentation with U-Net
abstract: U-Net based segmentation of medical images for tumor boundary detection. Applied to brain MRI scans with data augmentation to handle limited training samples.

title: AI Chatbot for Mental Health Support
abstract: Conversational AI chatbot for preliminary mental health assessment and support. Uses fine-tuned GPT model with safety guardrails to provide empathetic responses and crisis resources.

title: Sentiment Analysis of Product Reviews
abstract: Sentiment analysis system for e-commerce product reviews using BERT fine-tuning. Classifies reviews into positive, negative, and neutral with aspect-level granularity.

title: Automated Text Summarization Engine
abstract: Abstractive text summarization system using T5 transformer. Summarizes news articles, research papers, and long documents while preserving key information and context.

title: Multilingual Chatbot for Customer Service
abstract: Customer service chatbot supporting 10 Indian languages using mBERT for intent classification and Google Translate API for response generation. Handles FAQs and ticket creation.

title: Smart Home Automation with Voice Control
abstract: IoT-based smart home system with voice control using Alexa Skills Kit. Controls lights, fans, and appliances through voice commands and a mobile dashboard.

title: Industrial IoT Monitoring Platform
abstract: Real-time industrial equipment monitoring using IoT sensors. Predicts machine failures using LSTM-based time series analysis and sends alerts to maintenance teams.

title: Real-time Object Detection for Autonomous Vehicles
abstract: YOLOv8-based object detection system for autonomous driving. Detects pedestrians, vehicles, traffic signs, and lane markings in real-time from dashboard camera feeds.

title: Sign Language Recognition System
abstract: Real-time Indian Sign Language recognition using MediaPipe hand tracking and LSTM. Translates hand gestures into text and speech to bridge communication gaps.

title: Food Waste Detection and Classification
abstract: Computer vision system for detecting and classifying food waste in cafeterias. Uses YOLOv8 for detection and ResNet for classification to track waste patterns and reduce food wastage.

title: AI-Powered Resume Screening System
abstract: Automated resume screening using NLP to match candidates with job descriptions. Uses TF-IDF and BERT embeddings for semantic matching with explainable ranking criteria.

title: AI Music Recommendation System
abstract: Music recommendation engine using collaborative filtering and content-based approaches. Analyzes listening patterns and audio features to suggest personalized playlists.

title: Generative AI Art Platform
abstract: Web platform for generating AI art using Stable Diffusion. Users can create paintings, illustrations, and designs with text prompts and style transfer options.

title: Smart Traffic Management System
abstract: AI-powered traffic management system using CCTV feeds and YOLO for vehicle counting. Dynamically adjusts signal timings based on real-time traffic density analysis.

title: Blockchain-based Certificate Verification
abstract: Decentralized certificate verification system using Ethereum blockchain. Educational institutions issue tamper-proof digital certificates that employers can verify instantly.

title: Predictive Maintenance for Wind Turbines
abstract: Machine learning system for predicting wind turbine failures using SCADA sensor data. Random Forest and XGBoost models predict component failures 48 hours in advance.
